item.tib: de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug gtor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar po can gyi rgyud las 'khor lo yid bzhin dbang rgyal
item.coloph: ces gshen rab mchog de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug gtor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar po can gzhan gyis mi thub pa phyir bzlog pa chen mo'i rgyud las 'khor lo yid bzhin nor bu dbang rgyal zhes bya ba 'di ni/ rang snang rtogs pa'i nying 'khrul bag tsam la brten nas/ bstan dang 'gro la phan bde bskyed nus kyi blo dang bcas kho bo kun grol grags pa bdag gis ke tshang nyi ma rang shar gyi gnas su sa rta zla ba drug pa'i tshes brgyad kyi nyin du brtsams pa dge zhing legs pa'i bkra shis//
